MANY.gloss: a quantifier that can be used with count nouns and is often preceded by `as' or `too'…
MANY.definition: A quantifier that can be used with count nouns and is often preceded by `as' or `too' or `so' or `that'; amounting to a large but indefinite number.

ANY.gloss: one or some or every or all without specification
ANY.definition: One or some or every or all without specification.
ANY.example: Give me any peaches you don't want.

MAY.gloss: thorny Eurasian shrub of small tree having dense clusters of white to scarlet flowers…
MAY.definition: Thorny Eurasian shrub of small tree having dense clusters of white to scarlet flowers followed by deep red berries; established as an escape in eastern North America.

MAN.gloss: an adult person who is male
MAN.definition: An adult person who is male (as opposed to a woman).
MAN.example: There were two women and six men on the bus.

FAN.gloss: a device for creating a current of air by movement of a surface or surfaces
FAN.definition: A device for creating a current of air by movement of a surface or surfaces.

AIM.gloss: point or cause to go towards
AIM.definition: Point or cause to go (blows, weapons, or objects such as photographic equipment) towards.
AIM.example: Please don't aim at your little brother!

MIN.gloss: a unit of time equal to 60 seconds or 1/60th of an hour
MIN.definition: A unit of time equal to 60 seconds or 1/60th of an hour.

FIN.gloss: the cardinal number that is the sum of four and one
FIN.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of four and one.
